title: Emergency conference at Camp Hood on nuclear-site UFOs

tellings.quote: an emergency conference was held at Camp Hood, Texas, which included the Air Force Office of Special Investigations, the Army Counter Intelligence Command, and the FBI.

plain: Unexplained objects seen around nuclear sites are said to have prompted an emergency conference at Camp Hood, Texas, attended by the Air Force Office of Special Investigations (the Air Force's own investigators), the Army Counter Intelligence Command and the FBI. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source or a date, in an episode about UFOs and nuclear weapons. If true, it would mean the military and the FBI treated the sightings as a serious security matter.
